scope: Offline stronger-center planner screen; 50% one-core CPU duty; no ROS/DDS/Gazebo process or robot motion

metric_scope.length: Published polyline arc length; fixed final heading/dwell excluded.
metric_scope.heading: Absolute wrapped heading change of nonzero geometry segments; not vehicle rotation.
metric_scope.static: Exact continuous segment-to-raw occupied/unknown square distance minus .22m; map exterior also blocked.
metric_scope.interior: Mean sampled center-to-static-square distance minus .22m at 5cm arc spacing, omitting first/last ~30cm; not a continuous certificate.
metric_scope.box: Exact continuous segment-to-physical 25cm rectangle distance minus .22m.
metric_scope.simulated_prerequisites: Fake fresh scan/odom/TF/health/automatic authority. Real prearm, actuator tracking, WiFi, DWB, and sensor noise are NOT tested.
metric_scope.recommendation: All clean/global/local/extra certified cases must be noncontact and feasible; both route lengths <=baseline+5%; clean interior mean gap improves >1mm. Selection is screening only.
